entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT de-abstraction for generated ReadOnlyArray works for static not for instance fields #122856
  • [API Proposal]: Add Math.DivRem and Math.IEEEDivRem for floating point types #122855
  • Unify Generic Host APIs: unseal HostApplicationBuilder and add Build() to IHostApplicationBuilder #122854
  • The application hangs and then crashes (unmanaged heap corruption) #122853
  • Diagnostics.TagList does not support IEnumerable or CopyTo when Empty #122848
  • IndexOutOfRangeException in ILCompiler.LazyGenericsSupport.GraphBuilder.WalkMethod #122845

Closed

  • Xcode project when building for simulators only sometimes runs tests #50663
    Future
  • dotnet-policy-service is closing stale issues as completed #122851
  • Windows x86 Checked CLR build using -O2 hits runtime asserts #59845
    Future
  • AARCH64 optimizer leaves a redundant mov instruction #122844
  • BUG：Some bug in Balancing Group of Regular Expressions #111161
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Cleanup some dead paths in EH #122852
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix regression introduced by recent PR #122850
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix TagList.CopyTo to not throw when TagList is empty #122849
    area-System.Diagnostics.Activity, 11.0.0

Merged

  • Cleanup always-on FEATURE_EH_FUNCLETS #122833
    area-VM-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [browser][coreCLR] detect browser features and fail fast #122799
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] fix incremental build #122798
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Use /O2 for Windows x86 Checked #122846
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, community-contribution

Updated

  • [wasm][coreclr] Fix struct layout #122704
    arch-wasm, area-TypeSystem-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Add 'physicalMemoryMode' to SRC.MemoryCache. New mode will follow GC metrics to determine trimming. #117886
  • Wasm various fixes #122627
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix UnsafeAccessor signature for byref struct this #122754
    area-System.Runtime.CompilerServices, community-contribution
  • [browser][coreCLR] JS modules consistency via gitHash #122801
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] rollup improvements #122814
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Fix System.Timers.Timer Stop() not working after setting AutoReset or Interval on disabled one-shot timer #122843
    area-System.ComponentModel
  • Add missing filesystem magic numbers to UnixFileSystemTypes enum #122829
    area-System.IO
  • Fix ZIP64 header corruption when large file at large offset #122837
    area-System.IO.Compression
  • Fix duplicate serialization of virtual properties with JsonPropertyName on base class #122842
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Fix JsonNode.GetPath() to properly escape characters in property names #122841
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Fix JsonSerializer.Serialize producing invalid JSON for [JsonExtensionData] with JsonObject #122838
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Fix StackOverflowException serializing dictionary with string key and object-converter that handles string #122835
    area-System.Text.Json
